what: Three panel-size photo cells stand stacked and look split into thirds via clip-path. Hovering one cell widens it to 70% (1.2s power4.inOut) while the other cells are pushed to 15% at each end, with photos blurring 15px and shifting 15%. A big title in the middle of the widened cell turns on in .6s power2.in, and the small title standing at the left of each cell turns off in .3s. When the pointer leaves, it returns to thirds with the same curve.

options.narrow: Collapsed column width (%), default 15 — a wide column is 100 − (column count − 1) × narrow
options.ease: Curve in the ”0.16,1,0.3,1” form or a GSAP name, default power4.inOut
options.min: Not applied at or below this width (px) and the columns are left as they are (stack them vertically with your own CSS), default 899
options.[data-fx-part=slice]: Cell (direct child of the panel) — a link is fine
options.[data-fx-part=image]: Photo panel that shifts and blurs inside the cell (make it wider than the cell so the edges don’t show)
options.[data-fx-part=small]: Small title standing at the left of each cell (cell start + 2.5%)
options.[data-fx-part=big]: Large title that lights up in the center of the open panel
